exports.name: ColorPickerComponent
exports.summary:
Material-style palette color picker: pick a base color then a shade (hue), implements
`ControlValueAccessor` so it works with Angular forms.
exports.summaryZh:
Material 风格的调色板颜色选择器：先选基础色再选色阶（hue），实现了 `ControlValueAccessor`，
可直接用于 Angular 表单。

inputs.name: color
inputs.descriptionZh: 当前颜色，编码为 `<调色板>-<色阶>` 格式（如 `red-500`）。

outputs.name: colorChanged
outputs.description: Emits the selected color object whenever it changes.
outputs.descriptionZh: 选中颜色发生变化时发出对应的颜色对象。

methods.name: selectPalette
methods.description: Switches to the hue-selection view for the given palette.
methods.descriptionZh: 切换到给定调色板的色阶选择视图。

methods.name: selectHue
methods.description: Selects the given hue within the currently selected palette.
methods.descriptionZh: 在当前选中的调色板内选择给定的色阶。

methods.name: removeColor
methods.description: Clears the current selection and returns to the palette-selection view.
methods.descriptionZh: 清除当前选择并返回调色板选择视图。

methods.name: updateSelectedColor
methods.descriptionZh: 执行 `updateSelectedColor`，用于更新已选中颜色。

methods.name: goToPalettesView
methods.description: Returns to the palette-selection view without changing the current selection.
methods.descriptionZh: 返回调色板选择视图，不改变当前选择。

methods.name: onMenuOpen
methods.description:
Sets the initial view (palettes or hues) shown when the picker menu opens, based on
whether a palette is already selected.
methods.descriptionZh: 根据是否已选中调色板，设置选择器菜单打开时显示的初始视图（调色板或色阶）。

properties.name: colors
properties.descriptionZh: 可选的调色板集合，来自 `MatColors.all`。

properties.name: view
properties.descriptionZh: 当前显示的面板视图：`'palettes'`（调色板）或 `'hues'`（色阶）。

properties.name: selectedColor
properties.descriptionZh: 当前选中的颜色对象（含 palette/hue/class/bg/fg）。

properties.name: selectedPalette
properties.descriptionZh: 当前选中的调色板名称。

properties.name: color
properties.descriptionZh: 当前颜色，编码为 `<调色板>-<色阶>` 格式（如 `red-500`）。

exports.name: ColorPickerModule
exports.summary: Angular module `ColorPickerModule` declaring and exporting color picker module components, directives, pipes, and providers.
exports.summaryZh: Angular 模块 `ColorPickerModule`，声明并导出颜色选择器模块相关的组件、指令、管道与服务提供者。

exports.name: MATERIAL_COLOR_PICKER_VALUE_ACCESSOR
exports.summary: Constant/variable `MATERIAL_COLOR_PICKER_VALUE_ACCESSOR` defining material color picker value accessor in `src/common/matcolorpicker`.
exports.summaryZh: 常量/变量 `MATERIAL_COLOR_PICKER_VALUE_ACCESSOR`，定义 `src/common/matcolorpicker` 中的MATERIAL颜色选择器值访问器。
